title: Nextech3D.ai CEO discusses ARway acquisition strategy - ICYMI

Nextech3D.AI (CSE:NTAR, OTCQX:NEXCF, FRA:1SS) earlier this week announced progress toward acquiring the remaining ownership interest in ARway, a move that Chief Executive Officer Evan Gappelberg said would simplify the company's structure while strengthening its software-focused growth strategy.

Speaking with Proactive, Gappelberg said the transaction should not be viewed as a conventional acquisition because Nextech3D.AI (CSE:NTAR, OTCQX:NEXCF) already owns approximately 40% of ARway and has spent several years integrating its technology, customer relationships and product strategy.

He said completing the acquisition would allow the businesses to operate under a single platform, engineering team and go-to-market strategy while eliminating operational duplication.

Proactive: Welcome back inside our Proactive newsroom. Joining me is Evan Gappelberg, CEO of Nextech3D.ai. Good to see you again. How are you?

Evan Gappelberg: I'm good. Great to be back.

Last time we spoke during one of our live events, investors were asking about ARway and the plans to bring it back into the main Nextech business. You have an update today.

We are moving forward with the acquisition of the remaining ownership of ARway. This isn't a traditional acquisition because we already own about 40% of ARway. We've spent years integrating the technologies, customers and product strategy. What changes now is the ownership structure. We move from operating two companies to one company, one platform, one engineering team and one go-to-market strategy.

The transaction brings about $1.5 million in annual ARway revenue and approximately $1.5 million in profit. It's a very profitable business, so it's immediately accretive from a revenue perspective. It also moves us further toward a software-driven revenue business while simplifying things for shareholders. We've heard questions about ARway, Nextech and even Toggle, so simplifying the corporate structure, eliminating duplication, streamlining operations and creating a more scalable organization is important.

ARway is clearly central to what you're doing now.

It is. Our goal is to become the operating system for live events. Every acquisition supports that vision. ARway has been showing strong growth with gross margins above 90%, so we don't believe it should continue as a standalone company.

Across Nextech, sales momentum is accelerating. ARway is part of that. We're seeing larger enterprise deals and multi-year contracts. Where we previously signed one-year agreements almost exclusively for Map D, nearly every new agreement is now for two, three or four years. That gives shareholders greater confidence because the business becomes less dependent on annual renewals.

积极主动的

Nextech3D.AI（CSE：NTAR，OTCQX：NEXCF，FRA：1SS）本周早些时候宣布在收购 ARway 剩余所有权方面取得进展，首席执行官 Evan Gappelberg 表示此举将简化公司结构，同时加强其以软件为中心的增长战略。

Gappelberg 在接受 Proactive 采访时表示，此次交易不应被视为传统收购，因为 Nextech3D.AI（CSE：NTAR，OTCQX：NEXCF）已经拥有 ARway 约 40% 的股份，并花了数年时间整合其技术、客户关系和产品战略。

他表示，完成收购将使两家公司能够在单一平台、工程团队和进入市场战略下运营，同时消除运营重复。

Proactive：欢迎回到我们的 Proactive 新闻编辑室。 与我一起的是 Nextech3D.ai 首席执行官 Evan Gappelberg。 很高兴再次见到你。 你好吗？

埃文·加佩尔伯格：我很好。 很高兴回来。

上次我们在一场现场活动中发言时，投资者询问了 ARway 以及将其带回主要 Nextech 业务的计划。 今天有更新。

我们正在推进收购 ARway 剩余所有权的工作。 这不是传统的收购，因为我们已经拥有 ARway 约 40% 的股份。 我们花了数年时间整合技术、客户和产品策略。 现在改变的是股权结构。 我们从运营两家公司转变为运营一家公司、一个平台、一支工程团队和一项进入市场战略。

此次交易为 ARway 带来约 150 万美元的年收入和约 150 万美元的利润。 这是一项非常有利可图的业务，因此从收入角度来看它会立即增值。 它还使我们进一步走向软件驱动的收入业务，同时为股东简化了事情。 我们听说过有关 ARway、Nextech 甚至 Toggle 的问题，因此简化公司结构、消除重复、简化运营和创建更具扩展性的组织非常重要。

ARway 显然是您现在所做工作的核心。

这是。 我们的目标是成为现场活动的操作系统。 每一次收购都支持这一愿景。 ARway 一直表现出强劲的增长势头，毛利率超过 90%，因此我们认为它不应该继续作为一家独立公司。

Nextech 的销售势头正在加速。 ARway 是其中的一部分。 我们看到了更大的企业交易和多年期合同。 我们之前几乎专门为 Map D 签署了一年协议，而现在几乎每份新协议都是两年、三年或四年。 这给了股东更大的信心，因为业务对年度续约的依赖减少了。
